title: More on area
competency: Find areas of regions above and below the x-axis.

keywords.def: Area counted positive above the x-axis and negative below it.

ideas.name: Area above and below the x-axis

en.text: A definite integral counts area above the x-axis as positive and below as negative. For the true area, find where the graph crosses the axis, split the interval there, and add the absolute values: below the axis use −∫.

am.text: ዴፊኒት ኢንቲግራል ከ x-ዘንግ በላይ ያለውን አዎንታዊ፣ በታች ያለውን አሉታዊ ይቆጥራል። እውነተኛ ስፋት ለማግኘት በመቋረጫ ነጥቦቹ ከፍለን እንደምራለን።

screens.title: A negative area?
screens.ask: ∫ from 0 to 2 x² dx = 8/3. What is ∫ from 0 to 2 (−x²) dx?
screens.after:
−x² is the graph of x² flipped below the x-axis.
The region has the same size, 8/3.
Below the axis the heights are negative, so the integral is −8/3.
The area itself is still 8/3: area = −(integral) below the axis.

screens.title: Area below the axis
paras: If f(x) ≥ 0 on [a, b], the area is ∫ from a to b of f(x) dx.
If f(x) ≤ 0 on [a, b], the area is −∫ from a to b of f(x) dx.
If f changes sign, split at the x-intercepts and add the areas.

screens.title: y = x − 2 on [0, 4]
screens.ask: Tap the points. One triangle is below the axis, one above.

points.info: Below the axis on [0, 2]: a triangle of area (1/2)(2)(2) = 2. It counts −2 in the integral.
The x-intercept. Split the region here.
Above the axis on [2, 4]: area 2, counts +2. The integral is −2 + 2 = 0, but the area is 2 + 2 = 4.

screens.title: Key words
defs: Area counted positive above the x-axis and negative below it.

screens.ask: Area of a region below the x-axis: f(x) = x² − 1 on [−1, 1]. The area = ___
screens.why:
On [−1, 1], x² − 1 ≤ 0: the graph is below the axis.
F(x) = x³/3 − x.
∫ = F(1) − F(−1) = (−2/3) − (2/3) = −4/3.
Area = −(−4/3) = 4/3.
Trap: an area is never negative.
screens.clue: The graph is below the axis here.

screens.title: f(x) = x² − 1 on [0, 2]
steps: The graph crosses the axis at x = 1.

screens.ask: Area enclosed by a curve and the x-axis: f(x) = x² − 4. The area = ___
screens.why:
x-intercepts: x² − 4 = 0 gives x = ±2.
Between them the graph is below the axis.
F(x) = x³/3 − 4x. F(2) = 8/3 − 8 = −16/3, F(−2) = 16/3.
∫ from −2 to 2 = −16/3 − 16/3 = −32/3.
Area = 32/3.

screens.ask: Area enclosed by a curve and the x-axis: f(x) = x² − 2x. The area = ___
screens.why:
x-intercepts: x(x − 2) = 0 gives x = 0 and x = 2.
Between them the graph is below the axis (f(1) = −1).
∫ from 0 to 2 = [x³/3 − x²] = 8/3 − 4 = −4/3.
Area = 4/3.

screens.ask: Area under a curve above the x-axis: f(x) = x² + 3 between x = −1 and x = 3. The area = ___

screens.text: Sign of the definite integral: is each integral positive, negative or zero?
items: 8/3: the region is above the axis.
−8/3: the region is below the axis.
screens.why:
Above the axis counts +, below counts −.
The integral = (area above) − (area below).
If the two parts are equal, the integral is 0, but the area is not.
screens.clue: Sketch each graph. Where is it above, where below the x-axis?

screens.text: Signed area: ∫ from −1 to 2 (−x³ + 3x − 1) dx is
screens.why:
F(x) = −x⁴/4 + 3x²/2 − x.
F(2) = −4 + 6 − 2 = 0.
F(−1) = −1/4 + 3/2 + 1 = 9/4.
∫ = 0 − 9/4 = −9/4.
Negative: more of the region is below the axis than above.
Trap: 9/4 subtracts in the wrong order.
screens.clue: More of this graph is below the axis.

screens.ask: Area enclosed by a cubic and the x-axis: f(x) = x(x + 2)(x − 1). The area = ___
screens.why:
Intercepts: x = −2, 0, 1. Expand: f = x³ + x² − 2x.
F(x) = x⁴/4 + x³/3 − x².
Above on [−2, 0]: F(0) − F(−2) = 0 − (4 − 8/3 − 4) = 8/3.
Below on [0, 1]: F(1) − F(0) = 1/4 + 1/3 − 1 = −5/12, area 5/12.
Total area = 8/3 + 5/12 = 32/12 + 5/12 = 37/12.
Trap: ∫ from −2 to 1 = 9/4 lets the parts cancel.
screens.clue: Split at −2, 0 and 1. The integral alone (9/4) is not the area.

items.ask: Area enclosed by f(x) = x² − 4 and the x-axis: S = ___
items.why:
Intercepts ±2; the graph is below the axis between them.
∫ from −2 to 2 (x² − 4) dx = −32/3.
S = −(−32/3) = 32/3.

items.ask: Area enclosed by f(x) = −x² + 4 and the x-axis: S = ___
items.why:
Intercepts ±2; the graph is above the axis between them.
F(x) = −x³/3 + 4x. F(2) = 16/3, F(−2) = −16/3.
S = 16/3 + 16/3 = 32/3.

items.ask: Area enclosed by f(x) = x² − 2x and the x-axis: S = ___
items.why:
Intercepts 0 and 2; below the axis between them.
∫ from 0 to 2 = 8/3 − 4 = −4/3.
S = 4/3.

items.ask: Area enclosed by f(x) = −x² − 2x and the x-axis: S = ___
items.why:
−x(x + 2) = 0 gives x = −2 and x = 0. Above the axis between them.
F(x) = −x³/3 − x².
F(0) = 0. F(−2) = 8/3 − 4 = −4/3.
S = 0 − (−4/3) = 4/3.

items.ask: Area under f(x) = x² from x = 0 to x = 4: S = ___
items.why:
x² ≥ 0, so the integral is the area.
F(x) = x³/3.
S = 64/3 − 0 = 64/3.

items.ask: Area enclosed by f(x) = x(x + 2)(x − 1) and the x-axis: S = ___
items.why:
Split at the intercepts −2, 0, 1.
Above on [−2, 0]: 8/3.
Below on [0, 1]: 5/12.
S = 8/3 + 5/12 = 37/12.

test.ask: Area of a region below the x-axis: y = −x² from 0 to 3. The area = ___
test.why:
−x² ≤ 0: the region is below the axis.
∫ from 0 to 3 (−x²) dx = −27/3 = −9.
Area = −(−9) = 9.

test.ask: Total area between y = x − 1 and the x-axis on [0, 3] = ___
test.why:
y = x − 1 crosses the axis at x = 1: split there.
Below on [0, 1]: triangle (1/2)(1)(1) = 1/2.
Above on [1, 3]: triangle (1/2)(2)(2) = 2.
Area = 1/2 + 2 = 2.5.
Trap: the integral (1.5) subtracts the part below.

test.text: True or false? If f(x) < 0 on [a, b], the integral from a to b is negative.
test.why:
Every height f(x) is negative.
So every Riemann term f(x)Δx is negative.
Their limit, the integral, is negative.
True (the area is minus the integral).

test.ask: Area enclosed by y = 1 − x² and the x-axis = ___
test.why:
Intercepts: 1 − x² = 0 gives x = ±1. Above the axis between them.
F(x) = x − x³/3.
F(1) = 2/3. F(−1) = −2/3.
Area = 2/3 + 2/3 = 4/3.

notes.text: Example 4 (p.146) writes S = ∫ from 0 to 2 (x² − 1) dx (that is 2/3, not the area) and says the area above exceeds the area below "by 2" (it is by 2/3). The final area 2 is correct.
Example 3 labels both parts "a"; the second is part b.

screens.text: Evaluate the definite integral: ∫ from 1 to 2 3x² dx = ?
screens.why:
Anti-derivative: F(x) = x³.
F(2) = 8. F(1) = 1.
8 − 1 = 7.
Trap: 8 forgets to subtract F(1).
